policy: Named vegetable types and different plant parts are separate canonical rows next to the untouched generic rows (cabbage, beans, celery seed, mustard, pumpkin seeds, water). Colour-shade, cultivar, size and cut variants are collapsed by the rule's canonical table and listed as synonym CANDIDATES (synonyms.csv untouched).

separate_rows.bok choy cabbage: a named cabbage type kept as its own food name next to the untouched generic 'cabbage' row
separate_rows.chinese cabbage: a named cabbage type (pe-tsai) next to the generic 'cabbage' row
separate_rows.napa cabbage: a named cabbage type next to the generic 'cabbage' row (whether napa and chinese cabbage are one food is not stated by FDC; both kept)
separate_rows.savoy cabbage: a named cabbage type next to the generic 'cabbage' row
separate_rows.snap beans: a named bean pod vegetable next to the untouched generic 'beans' legume row
separate_rows.mustard greens: the leaf vegetable; 'mustard' is the seed spice, a different plant part, left untouched
separate_rows.mustard spinach: a leaf vegetable (tendergreen); 'mustard' is the seed spice, left untouched
separate_rows.pumpkin: the fruit-vegetable; 'pumpkin seeds' is a different plant part (nut_seed row), left untouched
separate_rows.water convolvulus: a leaf vegetable; the shared word 'water' with the existing 'water' row is incidental (false variant match)
